label: Puerto Rico · Nov 7–14
summary: El Yunque, Culebra turtle snorkel, Vieques: brightest bio bay, horses, reefs; east only, ferry, ~$2,047 pp.
title: Puerto Rico: Rainforest, Reefs & Vieques Bio Bay
overview:
- **Dates:** LAX Sat Nov 7 → LAX **Sat Nov 14**. 7 nights in PR, 0 on planes. 1-stop flights both ways.
- **Route (east only):** Old San Juan 1n → Luquillo/El Yunque 3n → Vieques (Esperanza) 2n → Isla Verde 1n. Southwest dropped: too far.
- **Bio bay:** Mosquito Bay, Vieques, **Wed Nov 11** ~19:30: brightest bay; moon 7%, sets 19:31. Nov 12 = rain backup. One bay only.
- **Snorkel:** **Tue Nov 10** catamaran Fajardo → Culebra reefs (turtles, rays). Vieques Nov 11–12: Playa Esperanza, Mosquito Pier.
- **Nature:** El Yunque at 08:00 gate, coquí nights, Vieques refuge beaches, wild horses, Playa Negra.
- **Getting there:** Car Nov 8–13 (parked at Ceiba Nov 11–13). Ceiba → Vieques passenger ferry ($2/leg). Jeep on Vieques.
- **Culture:** Old San Juan forts (NPS), Fortín Conde de Mirasol.
- **Pace:** max ~1h driving/day. Nov 12 slow. ~$2,047 pp.

itinerary.title: Fly to Puerto Rico
itinerary.details: Early 1-stop (via MIA/CLT/DFW/ATL/JFK). LAX ~06:00–08:00 → SJU ~18:00–21:00 (+4h clock). Taxi 20m to Old San Juan. Street food, sleep.

itinerary.title: Forts, then east
itinerary.details: 08:30 El Morro + San Cristóbal (one ~$10 fee). Paseo del Morro walk. Lunch. Taxi to SJU, pick up car ~13:00. ~50m PR-26/PR-3 east. Dusk: coquí chorus at inn.

itinerary.title: Rainforest, coquí night
itinerary.details: Gate 08:00 (PR-191 free, no reservation; closes at capacity: go early, Monday quieter). El Portal center ($8). Short trails open (check alerts; La Mina closed). Parrot/tody/lizard-cuckoo watch. Out by ~13:00. Nap, swim. Dusk: coquí walk with red light on inn grounds/Luquillo lanes (forest road closed after hours). No bio bay tonight: Mosquito Bay Nov 11 is brighter. Bed by 22:00: boat tomorrow.

itinerary.title: Culebra snorkel day (catamaran)
itinerary.details: 07:45 drive ~35m to Puerto del Rey marina, Fajardo. ~08:30–09:00 catamaran, ~45–50m crossing. Captain picks the calm spot: Tamarindo/Carlos Rosario (west side, Luis Peña reserve: turtles, reef) or Culebrita/Flamenco. 2 snorkel stops, beach time, buffet lunch, drinks, gear. Back ~15:00. Siesta. Easy dinner. Pack tonight: ferry tomorrow. Swell cancels? Fall back to Luquillo swim + kioskos.
itinerary.meals: B own; L on boat; D own

itinerary.title: Ferry to Vieques, brightest bio bay
itinerary.details: 08:00 drive ~35m to Ceiba terminal. Park in terminal lot (~$8–11/day). Morning passenger ferry (check timetable; window opens 1h before; Veterans Day holiday: book online, arrive early). ~45–75m crossing to Isabel II. Jeep handed over at dock. Optional 30m at Fortín Conde de Mirasol (museum, views). ~20m to Esperanza. Lunch on malecón. Easy snorkel off Playa Esperanza (seagrass: turtles, rays). Siesta. ~19:30 Mosquito Bay clear-kayak tour (~2h): thin 7% moon sets 19:31: dark.

itinerary.title: Horses, turtles, black sand
itinerary.details: Slow day, short jeep hops (15–25m). ~08:00 Mosquito Pier snorkel (calm side; turtles, rays, maybe manatee). Playa Negra: 10m walk down stream bed, dark volcanic sand. Lunch, siesta. ~16:00 refuge east beaches (Caracas, Pata Prieta; gates close ~sunset, check) or Sun Bay: wild horses graze by the road and on the sand. Sunset Esperanza. Bio bay backup tonight if Nov 11 rained out (moon 12%, sets 20:22: pick ~20:30 slot).

itinerary.title: Back to the big island
itinerary.details: Easy morning, last swim. Jeep back at dock. Late-morning ferry (~45–75m). Car from Ceiba lot, ~1h PR-53/PR-66 (tolls) to SJU, return car ~14:00. Hotel 5m. Beach walk; dinner at Piñones kioskos (10m) or Isla Verde.
itinerary.overnight: Isla Verde – Hotel Villa del Sol

itinerary.title: Fly home
itinerary.details: Slow breakfast. 5m to SJU. 1-stop SJU ~10:00–12:00 → LAX ~17:00–20:00 same day (~10h incl. connect).

practical:
## Entry
- US citizens: domestic flight. No passport. REAL ID or passport for TSA.

## Flights
- No nonstop LAX–SJU found. 1 stop: AA (MIA/CLT/DFW), Delta (ATL), JetBlue (JFK/BOS/MCO), Spirit/Frontier (MCO/FLL).
- Red-eyes exist (LAX ~22:00 → SJU ~noon next day) but cost a night. Plan: early Sat departure, arrive evening.
- PR = AST (UTC−4), no DST. LA = PST after Nov 1: **+4h** going east.

## Car? Yes, Nov 8–13 (drives Nov 8–11 + Nov 13).
- Needed for El Yunque 08:00, Puerto del Rey 07:45, Ceiba ferry. Uber thin outside metro.
- Rental cars can't go on the passenger ferry (contracts bar leaving main island). Park at Ceiba terminal lot ~$8–11/day, pick up Nov 13, return at SJU.
- Cheaper? Avis has a Ceiba branch (08:00–17:00): return there Nov 11 (if one-way OK) = 3 rental days, then taxi Ceiba → Isla Verde Nov 13 (~$90–120/car, unverified). Saves ~$25 pp at best; loses fallback. Not chosen.
- Tours-only = taxis + fixed pickups. Costs more.
- No car in Old San Juan nights: narrow streets, scarce parking.
- **AutoExpreso**: all tolls electronic. Rental tag mandatory; fee flat/day or per use + tolls. Ask at pickup. Tolls up slightly Jan 2026. This route: few tolls (PR-26/66/53).
- Distances in km, speed in mph, gas in liters. Driving assertive; potholes; avoid unlit mountain roads at night.

## Money
- USD. Cards widely; cash for kioskos, tips. NHS forts cashless.
- Tip 15–20%. Bio bay guides ~$10.

## Safety
- Generally fine for tourists. Usual car rules: nothing visible in car, esp. beach/trailheads.
- Bio bay: no sunscreen/repellent before kayak (harms organisms); follow guide. Life vest.
- Flash floods: stay out of rivers when raining upstream (El Yunque).

## Snorkel (Culebra Nov 10, Vieques Nov 11–12)
- Tour: lunch, drinks, mask/fins incl. Bring own mask if picky. Towel not incl.
- Tamarindo, Melones, Carlos Rosario = Canal Luis Peña reserve: no fishing, no touching/taking coral, no standing on reef. Keep ~3 m from turtles; no chasing.
- Reef-safe (mineral, zinc) sunscreen, or better: long-sleeve rash guard + hat. Apply 30m before.
- Nov = north swell season. North beaches (Flamenco, Carlos Rosario edge) can break; west/south (Tamarindo, Melones, Culebrita lee) calmer. Captain decides. Seasick-prone: pill before boarding.
- Water shoes: rocky, urchin entries at Tamarindo/Carlos Rosario.
- Water ~28°C: no wetsuit needed.
- Vieques: Playa Esperanza (seagrass, turtles, by the pier + in front of Trade Winds), Mosquito Pier (stay on calm side; morning). Strong current off points; never alone.

## Vieques
- **Ferry:** Ceiba (Roosevelt Roads) → Isabel II, passenger boat ~45–75m (reports 30m–1h30). $2/leg non-resident until Dec 31, 2026; $11.25/leg after. puertoricoferry.com: ~20% seats online, rest at window from 1h before. Residents first when full. Schedules shift; delays common.
- **Fly:** Vieques Air Link / Air Flamenco from Ceiba (NRR) ~10m; Cape Air SJU–VQS ~25m. Weight limits; small planes.
- **Getting around:** jeep (~$55–85/day) best: refuge roads rough. Golf carts ~$90–120/day, slow on hills. Públicos at ferry dock, few at night. Book ahead.
- **Bio bay:** Mosquito Bay, no swimming. No repellent/sunscreen before. Tours cancel in heavy rain; Nov 12 backup.
- **Refuge:** ex-Navy land; stay on open roads/beaches, don't enter fenced areas (unexploded ordnance). Gates close ~sunset. Horses: don't feed, give space; slow driving at night (horses on road).
- Gas stations few (Isabel II/Esperanza area); fill jeep early. Shops close early; Nov 11 holiday.

## Weather
- Highs ~29°C/84°F, lows ~22–24°C. Short showers, often afternoon. El Yunque wet any day.
- Hurricane season ends Nov 30: low but real risk. Watch NHC; free-cancel bookings.
- Rain/clouds dim bio bays. Bays close in storms. Ferry cancels in big swell.

## Packing
- Rain shell, quick-dry clothes, trail shoes with grip (slick), sandals, swimsuit, headlamp (red light for coquí), binoculars, repellent (mosquitoes + no-see-ums at dusk, esp. Vieques/Fajardo), reef-safe sunscreen, dry bag.

## Food
- Mofongo, lechón, alcapurrias, bacalaítos. Kiosk lunch $10–15; dinner $25–40 pp. Tap water OK in metro; bottled in rural spots after storms.

## Hotel deals
- Quotes above: room rate + tax, for 2. Room tax: 9% hotels, 11% casino hotels, 7% paradores + Airbnb. Resorts add resort fee ($20–40/night); small inns usually none.
- Book direct or with member rate (Marriott Bonvoy, Hilton Honors free sign-up; AAA) often 5–15% off + free cancel. Compare to Expedia/Booking total-with-tax.
- Hotels.com/Expedia may add a property service fee (~6%) at check-in; read the fine print.
- Discover Puerto Rico posts fall partner offers (Aug–Cyber Monday); check discoverpuertorico.com before Nov.
- Old San Juan: no hotel parking; Doña Fela garage ~$10/day (6'2" clearance). Plan has no car there.
- Vieques: small guesthouses; strict cancel windows; Esperanza = food + tours walkable.
- Airbnb: 7% tax + cleaning fee; for 1–3 nights rarely beats a small inn.
- Nov 13: Isla Verde (Villa del Sol) chosen: 5m to SJU, car drop then short hop. OSJ again = osj-last-night option.

fatigue_check:
Door-to-door travel per day:
- Nov 7 | 1-stop flight ~9h30 + 20m taxi | long-haul (daytime; sleep early)
- Nov 8 | 20m taxi + ~50m drive | light
- Nov 9 | 25m + 25m (El Yunque) | light; early night
- Nov 10 | 35m drive + ~6h boat day (2× ~50m crossings) + 35m | medium; seated boat, lunch served, back ~15:30
- Nov 11 | 35m drive + ferry ~45–75m (+45m wait) + 20m jeep; 2h kayak at night | medium (~2h30 travel); siesta
- Nov 12 | jeep hops 5–25m, ~1h total | light; slow day
- Nov 13 | 20m jeep + ferry ~45–75m + ~1h drive + 5m | medium (~2h30)
- Nov 14 | 5m + ~10h flight | long-haul home, same day

Rules:
- **Max ~3h driving/day:** met easily. Longest drive ~1h (Ceiba → SJU).
- **No back-to-back medium days:** BROKEN once (Nov 10 boat → Nov 11 ferry). Mitigated: Nov 9 easy + early night, Nov 10 back ~15:30, Nov 11 travel done by ~11:00, siesta before kayak.
- **Slow day mid-trip:** Nov 12 Vieques (short hops, siesta). Want more: keep-luquillo-slow.
- **Swim stops:** Culebra Nov 10; Esperanza Nov 11; Mosquito Pier + beaches Nov 12.
- 2 bases + 1-night bookends. ~6h less driving than southwest plan.
- Late nights: bio bay Nov 11 only (back ~21:30, slow Nov 12).
